content.html:
You can use fact families. A fact family is two addition sentences and two subtraction sentences that all use the same three numbers.


This is the fact family for 10 − 2 = 8:


10 − 2 = 8
10 − 8 = 2
8 + 2 = 10
2 + 8 = 10


Use the last fact. The number 2 must go in the blank space.

This is the fact family for 3 − 1 = 2:


3 − 1 = 2
3 − 2 = 1
1 + 2 = 3
2 + 1 = 3


Use the last fact. The number 3 must go in the blank space.

If 8 + 2 = 10, then...

10 − = 2​

If 8 + 2 = 10, then...

10 − = 2​

content.html:
You can use fact families. A fact family is two addition sentences and two subtraction sentences that all use the same three numbers.


This is the fact family for 8 + 2 = 10:


8 + 2 = 10
2 + 8 = 10
10 − 2 = 8
10 − 8 = 2


Use the last fact. The number 8 must go in the blank space.

html.html:
If 9 − 1 = 8, then...

1 + = 9​

If 9 − 1 = 8, then...

1 + = 9​

content.html:
You can use fact families. A fact family is two addition sentences and two subtraction sentences that all use the same three numbers.


This is the fact family for 9 − 1 = 8:


9 − 1 = 8
9 − 8 = 1
8 + 1 = 9
1 + 8 = 9


Use the last fact. The number 8 must go in the blank space.
